description: Use this when someone asks what documents, statements, or records to gather for a US tax filing or engagement: an individual return, a self-employed Schedule C return, a foreign-owned single-member LLC (Form 5472) filing, an S-corp or partnership return, an FBAR/Streamlined offshore catch-up, or an ITIN application. Returns the service-specific document list, first-year onboarding extras, and how to prepare files safely without implying that intake or uploads have opened.

first_year_client.description: Whether this is your first year working with the firm. Adds the one-time onboarding documents (prior returns, IDs, authorizations).

language.description: Language for an availability or waitlist handoff: English (en), Turkish (tr), or Spanish (es).

service.description: What the documents are for: "individual_return" (Form 1040), "self_employed_return" (1040 with Schedule C), "foreign_owned_llc_5472" (pro-forma 1120 + Form 5472 for a foreign-owned single-member US LLC), "s_corp_return" (Form 1120-S), "partnership_return" (Form 1065), "fbar_streamlined_catchup" (late FBARs / Streamlined offshore procedures), or "itin_application" (Form W-7).
